notes: «هو ابن عبد العزيز» is an editor gloss; left out
«قال كنا في دار أبي موسى» : Abu Ahwas narrates his own presence, and the speaker in his story is the last link (owner ruling 5)
Abu Mas'ud also speaks in the story; he is not written as a link, and the reply of أبو موسى is taken as the saying's speaker, which a reviewer may question
The Prophet's words quoted inside the story are not a link
